sources.snippet: An AI 3D Model Generator That Goes From Ideas to Assets Fast Manex3D turns reference images and plain-text prompts into fully textured, production-ready 3D models in under a minute. Generate clean geometry, high-quality materials, and game-ready topology, then export to GLB, OBJ, STL or PLY, and drop straight into your 3D model editor or game engine!
